title: buxus harlandii var. cephalantha
intro: Buxus harlandii var. cephalantha, commonly known as Japanese boxwood or Harland's boxwood, is a type of evergreen shrub native to China and Japan. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Buxus harlandii var. cephalantha include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids. However, the specific bioactive constituents of Buxus harlandii var. cephalantha have not been extensively studied, and more research is needed to determine their exact effects.
